# JSONata

JSONata 2.1.0 (MIT), vendored for local evaluation of ComfyUI node pricing expressions.
The ESM wrapper and license were copied from Creative Studio commit
`a774844eea165485e1b9204ceacd016840259253`, from
`web/integrations/comfyui/vendor/jsonata/`. CNL loads the local copy.
